summary: Comprehensive testing of new features in iteration 4: username-based authentication, menu categories CRUD, and user management CRUD. All 25 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend UI tests passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth correctly changed from email to username - login payload is now {username, password}
Username login is case-insensitive (converts to lowercase)
Menu categories CRUD properly implements soft-delete pattern (is_deleted flag)
User management correctly prevents self-deletion with 400 error
password_hash is properly excluded from user list API response
Category dropdown in menu form dynamically populated from /api/menu/categories
Public menu uses dynamic category ordering from API
Users tab shows avatar, username, role badge, and 'deg' badge for current user
All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing
seed_data_creation: Admin user seeded on startup. Test user 'martina' exists. 5 categories seeded (Bakst, Varm mat, Drikke, Spesielt, Dessert). 10 menu items seeded.
